title: Fun day
text:
This was a very enjoyable day.  Our guide Victoria was personable and helpful and our transportation comfortable.  
Jerez and the Spanish Riding Academy was wonderful especially if you appreciate horses.   Cadiz was lovely only wish we had had more time there.   Would do it again
author: Diane_K

title: Fun trip, Andalusian horse show amazing
text: The horse show was the highlight of this entire tour. The trip was more of a transportation to Jerez and Cadiz, but we enjoyed it a lot. Van was very comfortable and driver was reliable. Wish we had more time to wander around in Cadiz, but at least we got to be there and enjoy!
author: Suja_S

title: A tour full of information and a variety of experiences
text:
It was a wonderful excursion. Our guide was great.  On the trip she told us many facts about Spain.  The bus came to our hotel to pick us up which was wonderful. 

I loved the horse show, but I wish we had more time to walk around the stables.

The Tio Pepe sherry vineyard tour was informative and the sherry was delicious 

It was nice to walk around Cadiz and have lunch.
author: mazemarker

title: A good day out
text: The horse show and tour of the sherry cellars at Jerez were both excellent. The time in Cadiz for lunch would’ve been enhanced with recommendations of where to eat. Our driver Maria was well organised and punctual with all pick up and drop off’s at the various places and at each end of the day. She was friendly, efficient and knowledgeable and a good driver. With the air conditioned vehicle and the two inside venues it made for a pleasant day out even when the temperatures were nearing the high 35/36 Degrees C.
author: K1360PRsandrab

title: Jerez and Cadiz Day Trip
text: The day trip to Jerez and Cadiz was fantastic.  The bus pick us up from the hotel at the designated time.  The Winery was a great experience and the tour guide was fantastic in explaining how they made wine ending with a tasting.  The Royal Andalusian performance was spectacular!  I truly enjoyed the show.  The on your own time in Cadiz was fantastic.  It allowed us to view the city and shopping on our own and in just the right amount of time.
author: Olandreia_W

title: Andalusian Horse Show a must
text:
The Andalusian Horse Show was extremely impressive and should not be missed.
Cardiz even though not as impressive as Cardoba and Seville is still very picturesque to visit if you have time.
The tour guide Antonio made the day trip very enjoyable and his local knowledge was unlimited. Highly recommended.
author: Chris_C

title: Jerez and Cadiz
text: I had a great time on this trip. Our guide Toni was great, we felt like we were traveling with a friend. It was relaxing and beautiful. We visited the winery, otherwise I'm not exactly a wine person, but I'm glad I saw it, a great experience. We tried super fine Solera sherry wine :) . Toni gave us a lot of interesting information during the trip. It was educational. Cadiz was also beautiful, city/port. All in all, a recommendation!
author: Marija_G

text: Great trip! We had included on this day the Horse show, it was magical
